camel_example: aliyun iot GetDeviceTunnelStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ProductKey a1kqtIX0000 --DeviceName LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000
description_en: Queries the tunnel status of a gateway device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询网关设备的隧道状态
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-device-tunnel-status --product-key a1kqtIX0000 --device-name LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeviceTunnelStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID:
Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
Public instance: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID：
企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway belongs. A ProductKey is the unique identifier of a product
parameters.help_zh: 网关所属产品的Key，产品的唯一标识符
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The device name of the gateway device to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的网关设备名称
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en:
The response code:
Success: The call was successful.
Other values: An error code was returned. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en:
The data returned if the call was successful:
online: The gateway tunnel is enabled.
offline: The gateway tunnel is disabled

调用成功时，返回的数据：

offline：表示网关隧道已关闭
